snippet.textDisplay: It's hard to go from a fully functioning adult to someone who has to rely on another human
snippet.textOriginal: It's hard to go from a fully functioning adult to someone who has to rely on another human

snippet.textDisplay: The person they depend on the most becomes who they depend on inordinately as they feel like they are losing control of their lives, health, schedule, etc. It is not personal, but feels personal. Another caregiver may need to be asked to step in to handle the things that the elders "want fixed," so that the relationship with the one depended on most can be more about pleasant relating rather than problem-solving.
